```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(purrr)

pubs <- fromJSON("static/json/publications.json")

make_pub <- function(pub) {
    print(pub)
    title <- pub$title
    authors <- pub$authors
    year <- pub$year
    journal <- pub$journal
    doi <- pub$doi

    paste0(
        "<li><a href=\"", pub$url, "\">", title, "</a>",
        " (", authors, ", ", year, "). ", journal, ". ", doi, "</li>"
    )
}

pubs <- map(pubs, make_pub)
```
